messages:
elaine: Quick sync — after yesterday's launch we have a high-severity search regression reported by 3 customers and a handful of follow-on UX polish asks. Need to decide hotpatch vs backlog. Thoughts?

omar: Saw the reports. Regression looks like tokenization fallback when prompt contains special chars. Repro locally. Likely a small change but needs CI + canary.

lisa: Repro steps and failing test attached. Short snippet:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"search:\"x\""}'
Response: 500 tokenization fallback error: KV_NOT_FOUND
```

mike: Customer A & B marked this as blocking for their launch tomorrow, Customer C is less urgent. They're asking for an ETA.

sarah_p: The UX asks are mostly copy and spacing fixes in results. Low risk but need design review. Not customer-blocking.

omar: Two paths:
- Hotpatch: patch tokenization fallback, branch 2.4.1, CI -> canary -> full rollout. Est 2-3 hours.
- Bundle: include extra telemetry + fixes for edge cases and UX changes, full QA, ship next week.

elaine: Decision rule proposal: if "customer-blocking" -> hotpatch. If only cosmetic/perf -> backlog groom and schedule. Approve? :thinking_face:

lisa: +1. Also recommend smoke canary to 10% region with 30m hold and manual checks. I'll own checks.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued by @omar for rtp-us-east:10%. Link: https://deploys.redwood/1960012345

omar: Opening PR now -> BG-8472. Small change to tokenizer fallback logic + added a short unit test.

mike: I'll tell CS to mark Customers A/B as "hotpatch ETA 3h" and follow up if anything changes.

sarah_p: I'll log the UX tasks into the backlog with mockups and mark them P2. Figma: https://figma.com/file/ux-1960012345

elaine: Action items summary:
- @omar: hotfix PR, run canary, watch metrics
- @lisa: smoke tests + manual verification during canary
- @mike: customer comms and status updates
- @sarah_p: backlog items + design notes
We'll retro tomorrow morning to decide if any enhancements should be pulled in next sprint.

lisa: Canary started. Running smoke tests now.

lisa: Smoke tests green after 18m. No 500s in 1k requests.

deploy-bot: Canary completed successfully; promoting to 100% per rollout policy.

omar: Hotfix merged to 2.4.1 and deployed to prod. Closing BG-8472.

mike: Customers updated, relieved. They asked to keep us posted for any fallout.

elaine: Thanks team :tada: We'll keep the UX asks in backlog and prioritize in grooming next Wed. Closing thread.
